body: HQ-SPEC-AI-103 §4a build order step 1. New internal/fabledata package + cmd/fabledata: joins articles.ndjson against oracle.ndjson by SourceIdentity, keeps only reality-graded verdicts (confirmed/contradicts) per the spec's Lobian rule #1, computes a content-addressed manifest (sha256 over sorted example IDs, immutable once written), and wires the contamination-tombstone mechanism now even though fableeval/S145-02 hasn't landed yet (empty tombstone list today). 11 new tests, all green. go build/vet/test ./... clean across the whole repo. Ran against the live corpus: 0 graded examples today, correctly -- all 39 current oracle cases are pending (eps-reconciler hasn't resolved any yet), honest quiescence not a bug. Commit fff1d0e.
